inlines.v: ACROS'TIC, noun [Gr extremity or beginning, order, or verse.] A composition in verse, in which the first letter of the lines, taken in order, form the name of a person, kingdom, city, etc., which is the subject of the composition, or some title or motto. ACROS'TIC, adjective That relates to, or contains an acrostic
